calls.reason: This is a broad, opinion-laden claim with no specific implication named. The packet holds only launch posts, which include stated limitations, and no matched comparison of marketing against actual capability.
The monthly user figures are admitted guesses, and 25M/800M is still above 3%. Epoch's secondhand 35M subscriber figure points to a higher rate, but no matched primary counts were found.

The evidence is mixed. ZDNET found the agent mostly unreliable but got one detailed, accurate building-code analysis, and NN/g saw a slow but successful reservation. Two small case studies can't settle a categorical denial.
The companies, the time period and the accounting basis are unspecified. The packet gives only OpenAI's run rate and first-half figures, with no matched total of revenue and profit.

This is a forecast with no deadline. The strongest counterevidence is Anthropic's own report of teams handing work to agents, which is a self-report that doesn't measure how much human supervision remained.
